_spot_spike_note: Top threshold should track the current NEM Market Price Cap, which AEMO raises each 1 July (indexed) - it was $17,500 for FY2024-25. Check the current MPC and update this list each financial year.
_ntfy_note: ntfy.sh topics are unauthenticated - anyone who knows the topic string can subscribe. This repo is public, so the real topic names live in the NTFY_TOPICS_JSON GitHub Actions repository secret (same shape as this object) rather than here - nemweb_common.load_config() overrides this placeholder with that secret's contents at runtime. These placeholders are only used for a local/laptop run with no env var set.
_customer_note: customer_watch_all=true watches every DUID in the registry (all companies, all fuel types) rather than one portfolio - no fuel filter, so wind/solar noise is expected at this threshold. Set it back to false and use customer_portfolios (owner-name substrings, e.g. 'Origin Energy') if you want one specific company's assets instead.
_gas_spread_note: Both international_lng_jkm_usd_mmbtu (scraped live from tradingeconomics.com, a CFD-tracked proxy, not the official Platts benchmark) and audusd_fx_rate (live from frankfurter.app) are now fetched automatically each run by gas_spread_tracker.py. The values below are only a fallback used if a live fetch ever fails - update them occasionally so the fallback stays roughly sane, but they're no longer what drives the alert day to day. last_updated/staleness only applies when actually running on this fallback.
